question: 10 of the 15 STOP episodes left in squareT_platform_squareT_switch (26 frames, the train standing at the platform) come from a 2.2 x 0.41 x 1.25 m platform-end structure at 82.9 m, reported at lateral +0.96 m (envelope edge 1.05 m): the corridor axis is off at 83 m (EXPERIMENTS 1f, ALGORITHM 6). Fix it in the axis model without losing range on real curves.

diagnosis.measured_on: the shipped defaults at 7466979 (native path), per frame; no candidate had run when this was written
diagnosis.track_model_at_the_alarm_frames: curvature 2.5e-4 to 4.0e-4 /m (not 1.6e-4 as in 1f), rails in 3 slabs, two wall sides fitted; the axis is +0.47 m (absolute Y) at 83 m in frame 445 while the running tunnel beyond the hall (walls at +1.6 and -2.5 m, 90-120 m, frames 400-600 accumulated) is centred at about -0.45 m: the axis is ~0.8 m off, and the reported structure lies at ~1.8 m from the tunnel centre (its left wall / hall end face)
diagnosis.cause: the left boundary: a near structure at +1.6 m (6-33 m) joined by the robust quadratic to one bin at 44 m and one bin of the diverging hall end at 76 m; its far bins at 80-108 m lie off its own fit. Far support (boundary bins beyond rails_range[1] = 30 m within walls_max_residual of the side's final fit): left 2-4 of 7-10, right 15-23 of 17-24, on every standing frame 310-700. The two sides disagree by 2.4e-4 to 3.6e-4 (< axis_sides_max_disagreement 6.7e-4), so they are averaged by rms and the better-rms left side dominates (left k ~4e-4, right k 2e-5 to 1.5e-4). The rails' tangent is computed with the prior curvature held fixed, which feeds the bend back (yaw -0.0038 before the stop, -0.0065 to -0.0085 during it).
diagnosis.far_rail_check: track.rails_far_check_enabled never fires here (1f): no far rail pair in two slabs

open_loop_count_of_frames_the_rule_would.note: both sides fitted with a rail tangent, each with >= walls_min_bins far bins, exactly one below the threshold, the other at or above it with |k| <= 2e-4; counted on the default per-frame fits (open loop: the closed loop can differ)

fix: track.walls_min_far_support (float, 0 = off = today's code path; resense/track.py _far_supported_side): with both wall sides fitted and a rail tangent, a side whose boundary bins beyond rails_range[1] lie within walls_max_residual of its own fit in fewer than this fraction (sides with >= walls_min_bins far bins are judged) does not set the axis shape when the other side meets the fraction and is nearly straight (|k| <= track.walls_far_support_max_curvature = 2e-4 /m, R >= 5 km: a real R 350-1 000 m curve is never overruled). As for the existing nearer-side rule, only the shape (tangent, curvature, fit quality, supported range) comes from the one side; the side count and the disagreement that set the trusted range stay as fitted.
